calls.title: Discuss 4.4 release & general questions
calls.summary: The team discussed the plans for the 4.4 release, targeting the week of April 13th. The main feature, AI Data Analyst, is nearing completion and will launch in beta. Usage limits and pricing strategies are under consideration, with Elyse Fox conducting competitive analysis to inform tiering. The release also includes a significant revamp of feature flags and ongoing improvements in product analytics. A multi-tiered communication strategy is planned to enhance user understanding, while engineering constraints impacting demos were acknowledged. The emphasis is on rapidly innovating and ensuring clear upgrade paths to strengthen the product's competitive positioning.
calls.keywords: 4.4 Release, AI Data Analyst, Feature Flags, Beta Features, Pricing Strategy, Product Analytics
